summary: Require distinct declared execution units and deterministic bounded-handoff chaining for credited Adaptive Execution passes, then revalidate the merged Adaptive Execution behavior under the corrected discipline.
reason: PR #5 revision 6 recorded five SEPARATED semantic stages as complete even though they were effectively evaluated within one assistant response. The correction adds deterministic enforcement of unique declared execution-unit/boundary identities, ordered handoff chaining, closed historical exemptions, gate-before-pass chronology, historical identity uniqueness, immutable completed-pass evidence, and current artifact-state binding for partial subdivided completion. Revision-8 Adversarial found and corrected four successive defects: omission of the PR base snapshot from historical identity checks; mutation of execution identity after durable completion; an inability to represent subdivided execution honestly because subpasses were only recognized after the enclosing stage result became passing; and failure to validate a partial subpass completion against the current governed artifact state before that handoff could be consumed. The current model recognizes each completed plan pass before stage credit, permits only an ordered plan prefix, requires one durable state per completed pass with a pre-existing gate, withholds stage credit until the full plan is complete, freezes completed pass evidence historically, and requires every recorded completed pass to remain bound to the current artifact state. The gate used for the latest Adversarial attempt became stale when this correction changed governed files and has been discarded. Adversarial remains uncredited pending a fresh retry. The repository still does not claim to prove a ChatGPT message/context boundary unless the host supplies a trustworthy boundary ID.

supersedes_assurance.reason: The revision-6 semantic completion records overstated actual separation and are not used as evidence for the corrected review.
Revision-7 Adversarial completed before the historical uniqueness requirement for redo and subdivided execution occurrences was added; revision 8 therefore reopens from Adversarial.
